2608.25661.title: From General Agents to RCA Experts: A Self-Evolving Harness for Root Cause Analysis
2608.25661.paper_summary: Automated root cause analysis (RCA) with large language models (LLMs) has drawn growing attention. Today, SREs typically automate RCA with LLMs in one of two ways: directly using a general-purpose agent (e.g., Codex or Claude Code) for diagnosis, or building a specialized RCA agent from scratch. As mainstream general agents grow more capable and iterate quickly, our quantitative study finds that the former now often surpasses the latter. Its accuracy, however, still falls short of production needs, and this gap stems mainly from the external adaptation layer outside the agent's general capabilities, namely the harness. We therefore argue that LLM-based RCA should focus on this external harness, reusing the strong general capabilities of a modern agent rather than rebuilding an agent from scratch. A key capability of such a harness is to self-evolve, accumulating system-specific experience from past diagnoses so that it gets better the more it is used. We introduce OpsHarness, a self-evolving RCA harness that turns diagnosis experience into reusable expertise. Its data plane combines layered operational knowledge with an idea-card tool library, while its control plane coordinates setup, diagnosis, evolution, and verification. During evolution, OpsHarness contrasts successful and failed trajectories, converts their evidence into atomic proposals, and admits updates only through a dual-gate verification process designed to prevent overfitting and regression. Across two public benchmarks and an industrial deployment, OpsHarness achieves 59.0\% top-1 accuracy, improving over a bare general agent by 63.4\% and over baseline RCA agents by 4.02$\times$.
2608.25661.paper_summary_zh: 自動化根本原因分析 (RCA) 與大型語言模型 (LLMs) 引起了越來越多的關注。今天，SRE 通常以兩種方式之一使用 LLM 自動化 RCA：直接使用通用代理（例如，Codex 或 Claude Code）進行診斷，或從零開始構建專門的 RCA 代理。隨著主流通用代理變得越來越強大並迅速迭代，我們的定量研究發現，前者現在通常超過後者。然而，它的準確性仍然未達到生產需求，這一差距主要源於代理通用能力之外的外部適應層，即鞍帶。因此，我們主張基於 LLM 的 RCA 應該專注於這個外部鞍帶，重用現代代理的強大通用能力，而不是從頭開始重建一個代理。這樣的鞍帶的一個關鍵能力是自我演化，從過去的診斷中積累系統特定的經驗，以便隨著使用次數的增加而變得更好。我們介紹了 OpsHarness，一個自我演化的 RCA 鞍帶，將診斷經驗轉化為可重用的專業知識。它的數據平面結合了分層操作知識和一個理念卡工具庫，而它的控制平面協調設置、診斷、演化和驗證。在演化過程中，OpsHarness 對比成功和失敗的軌跡，將其證據轉化為原子提案，並僅通過設計用於防止過擬合和回歸的雙閘驗證過程來接受更新。在兩個公共基準和一個工業部署中，OpsHarness 實現了 59.0\% 的 top-1 準確率，較裸露的通用代理提高了 63.4\%，並較基準 RCA 代理提高了 4.02$\times$。
